name: KTM 790 / 890 Adventure
engine: 799 or 889 cc liquid-cooled LC8c parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: KTM's middleweight adventure twin. Early 790s had front and rear brake recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2019-2020 790 Adventures are in recalls 20V198 (rear brake hose can overheat) and 21V304 (front brake master cylinder spring). Some 2019-2023 bikes are in recall 22V588 (tires).
A-002.reason: Brake failures are a crash risk. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Rear brake hose may overheat and the rear brake can fail.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new brake line free.

recalls.what: Front brake master cylinder return spring may be too weak, reducing braking.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the return spring free.
